bio: Located near the pedestrian zone, this restaurant is a popular spot for authentic Japanese cuisine. If you want to avoid disappointment, be sure to make your reservations in good time! The decor is characteristically minimalist; there are also a few seats at the sushi counter. Tip: the reasonably priced lunchtime set menu. The options for dinner are wider ranging. At both lunchtime and in the evening, an additional vegetarian set menu is available. The wine list also includes sake, of course, and some regional wines....
